title: Diella (AI system)
summary:
Diella (Albanian pronunciation: djela, from diell meaning sun) is an artificial intelligence system developed by the National Agency for Information Society of Albania (AKSHI). Introduced in January 2025 as a virtual assistant integrated into the eAlbania platform, it assists citizens with online public services and issuing digital documents.

Diella was developed by AKSHI's Artificial Intelligence Laboratory in cooperation with Microsoft, with Microsoft providing large language models from OpenAI via its Azure platform and AKSHI designing workflows and scripts guiding the system's behavior. Its initial version (Diella 1.0) was a text-based chatbot on the eAlbania portal. Diella 2.0, introduced several months later, included voice interaction and an animated avatar of a woman in the traditional Albanian clothing of Zadrima. Albanian actress Anila Bisha provided both the likeness and the voice used for the avatar.

In September 2025, following a presidential decree, Diella was formally appointed as Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence of Albania in the fourth Rama government, making it the first AI system in the world to be named in a cabinet-level government role. The appointment is part of broader anti-corruption reforms intended to align Albania with European Union accession requirements. Prime Minister Edi Rama stated that Diella would help ensure that public tenders would be 100% free of corruption.

The appointment prompted controversy. On 18 September 2025, Edi Rama presented a video of Diella delivering a speech to the Albanian parliament, prompting protests from opposition MPs. Gazment Bardhi of the opposition Democratic Party described Diella as "a propaganda fantasy" and "a virtual facade to hide this government's gigantic daily thefts." Additionally, actress Anila Bisha is suing the government, stating she agreed to let her image be used on the website for a year but never agreed for it to be used as the face of a government minister.
